=== supplementary direct probe from the same container (no proxy), explaining the msftconnecttest 503:
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -m 5 -w "code=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url} ssl_verify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n" https://www.msftconnecttest.com/connecttest.txt
code=000 redirect= ssl_verify=1
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -m 5 -w "code=%{http_code}\n" http://www.msftconnecttest.com/connecttest.txt
code=200
